subject: Assessment: Format Your Database Entry
instructionString:
Rookie,

Here are the exact specifications for the digital database entry. Don't make me repeat myself.

1. Header & Name: Arial, 18pt
2. Staff Details (Role & Department): Arial, 14pt
3. Bio: Times New Roman, 12pt

Format your document accordingly before you submit it to the printer.

- Mrs. Santos

startingTextBlocks.text: Role: Probationary Staff Writer & Junior Encoder
Bio: First-year journalism student committed to campus transparency and reporting accurate student stories for The Paragon.
